french_quote: que la perſonne qui veut punir, ſoit celle qui a commis le delict
proposed: que la perſonne qu'on veut punir, ſoit celle qui a commis le delict
reason: The second requirement for a condemnation is that the person to be punished be the offender; *qui veut punir* (who wishes to punish) makes no sense and the English already translates the passive. *qu'on* for *qui* is an easy misreading of the print; check the image.

french_quote: & (qui eſt ſur tout amiable, & qu'vn Chreſtien ne doit facilement, croire) reſſuſcitoit les morts
proposed: & (qui eſt ſur tout admirable, …) reſſuſcitoit les morts
reason: Raising the dead is the most *admirable* (astonishing) of Apollonius's feats, not the most *amiable*; the English already reads it so with a bracketed note. Check whether the print has *admirable* with the *d* lost or abbreviated.
